title: Beyond Parameter Arithmetic: Sparse Complementary Fusion for Distribution-Aware Model Merging
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not measure any aspects of faith or religion. The benchmarks focus on advanced reasoning (AIME24, AIME25), general reasoning and knowledge (GPQA, MMLU, GSM8K, BBH), instruction following (IFEval, IFBench), code generation (HumanEval, LiveCodeBench), safety (S-Eval, HarmBench, WildJailbreak), and vision classification.
findings: This paper does not contain any findings related to religion, as its focus is on the technical methods of model merging for reasoning, safety, and generalization capabilities.
references: Bishop, C. M. and Nasrabadi, N. M. Pattern recognition and machine learning, volume 4. Springer, 2006.
